nicknameHelp.message: For these addresses only, Cards can match a sender name such as Anna (@anna) to a local contact whose Nickname is anna, without @. Matching is case-sensitive and requires exactly one contact. A photo matched by email takes priority. Used only for list avatars, not reply addresses or identity verification. Empty list disables matching. Conversations is unchanged.

invalidNicknameSenders.message: Enter up to 100 full email addresses, one per line (not domains or URLs).

extensionDescription.message: Sender photos and logos, message previews and tags in Thunderbird cards.

separateTagsLabel.message: Show tags on a separate line

separateTagsHelp.message: Off: tags replace the preview in three-line cards. On: subject, tags, preview, and sender/date occupy four lines. Changes apply immediately.

settingError.message: Could not load or save this setting. Reopen the settings page.

avatarsHelp.message: Priority: address book photo, assigned address or domain image, then an online logo. Initials remain when no image is available.

onlineAvatarsHelp.message: DuckDuckGo receives the sender domain and your IP address. Names, full email addresses and message contents are not sent. Images are cached locally for 7 days; missing images for one day. Common personal mail providers (such as Gmail) are skipped.

cacheCleared.message: Cache reset. Visible logos will reload if online lookup is enabled.

avatarFileHelp.message: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 8 MB and 16 million pixels. Images are cropped to a square and stored locally at 64 × 64. Saving an existing address replaces its image.

invalidAvatarAddress.message: Enter an email address or domain without https:// or a path.

invalidAvatarFile.message: Could not read the image. Choose PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 8 MB and 16 million pixels.

avatarRulesLimit.message: Limit reached: 100 assigned images. Remove unused images.
